title: Resolution approving city's federal community development funds budget
summary: This resolution approves the city's Fiscal Year 2027 Community Development Program totaling $241,587,000, a reallocation of $240,372,000 in Fifty-Second Year Community Development funds, and a proposed $241,212,000 Fifty-Third Year Community Development Program. The Fiscal Year 2027 total includes an added $375,000 for a Met Council Food Pantry program serving low- and moderate-income New Yorkers. These federally funded programs were submitted by the Mayor on May 12, 2026 and reviewed by the Council's Finance Committee.
